title: Holy Body vs the Prodigies
summary: Ye Fan tells Pang Bo he will enter a Life Forbidden Zone alone so that at least one of them survives to find the way home, and gives him Phoenix Blood Red Gold, a material fit for an extreme-grade weapon. He refuses Tingting's offer of Taiyin true blood, leaves a cauldron with her, and entrusts her to Jiang Taixu, who hands him the Qilin Divine Medicine seed for the road. Ye Fan gives An Miaoyi the Immortal Enlightenment Gem as a pledge to protect her path, and Hei Huang's 'strongest' teleport throws him one and a half million li off course. On a fifteen-day boat to the Southern Region he meets two young kings of Zhongzhou, Ye Huiling and Wang Chongxiao (both Four Poles), who are heading for the Forbidden Zone. After Wang Chongxiao crushes Xu Yueming of the Baiyue Sect with his Death King Gate, Ye Fan steps in, is mistaken for the Yaoguang Holy Son and then for the Ji Divine Body, and reveals himself with the Chaos Green Lotus. He shatters Wang Chongxiao's holy weapons with the Immortal Wall and more visions, and Wang Chongxiao withdraws. Ye Fan then reaches the edge of the Ancient Desolate Forbidden Land.
